description: This shell script tests the behavior of the GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES environment variable and related git commands, primarily focusing on the 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' command and its handling of directory ceiling restrictions, symbolic links, and path prefixes within a git repository context.

methods.name: test_prefix
methods.description: Checks that 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' returns the expected prefix when GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES is set appropriately.

methods.name: test_fail
methods.description: Ensures that 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' fails (exits with code 128) under certain directory ceiling restrictions.
